verdictEs: DIM para gestionar activamente tu inventario: mover gear, armar loadouts y limpiar el vault. Braytech para auditar tu progresión: vendor checklists, triumphs y collections. No compiten de frente; muchos jugadores usan ambas en la misma sesión.
verdictEn: DIM for actively managing your inventory: moving gear, building loadouts, and cleaning the vault. Braytech for auditing your progression: vendor checklists, triumphs, and collections. They don't compete head-on; many players run both in the same session.

useCases.reasonEn: DIM has a loadout builder, optimizer, and one-click gear transfer; Braytech doesn't manage inventory.
